definitions.gloss: many people, large number of people
definitions.explanation: A crowd or large group of people.

examples.japanese: {大勢|おおぜい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}きましょう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Let's go with a large group.
There were many people at the station.

notes:
{大勢|おおぜい} refers specifically to a large number of people.

IMPORTANT RESTRICTION:
{大勢|おおぜい} can ONLY be used for people, never for objects or animals.
- ✓ {大勢|おおぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: many people
- ✗ {大勢|おおぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧: (incorrect - use ⟦{多|おお}くの→多くの：23374_ookuno⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧)
- ✗ {大勢|おおぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧: (incorrect - use ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大勢|おおぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: many people
- {大勢|おおぜい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: with a large group, in large numbers
- {大勢|おおぜい}⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: to gather in large numbers
- {大勢|おおぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧: a large audience
- {大勢|おおぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧: many participants

ALTERNATIVES FOR 'MANY':
- ⟦{多|おお}くの→多くの：23374_ookuno⟧: many (general, formal)
- ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: many, lots of (general, casual)
- ⟦{数多|かずおお}くの→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧: numerous (formal)
- ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: large quantity (for things)

PRONUNCIATION:
The reading is おおぜい, not だいせい. This is an irregular reading.
